briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and xAI Colossus push AGI timelines to 2027 amid record funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scaling continues. US-China tensions intensify over export controls while safety frameworks lag deployment.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships Orion-2 with 4.2T parameters; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 weights under new license.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units/month; Microsoft activates Stargate phase 2 with 200k H100 equivalents. TSMC Arizona fab yields first 2nm AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve coherent long-horizon planning before 2028 or will coordination failures dominate?
